aboutH2: Searidge Foundation: Residential Addiction Treatment in Annapolis Royal, Nova Scotia
intro: Searidge Foundation is a leading residential treatment center situated in the scenic Annapolis Valley in Nova Scotia, Canada. The center offers a comprehensive approach to addiction recovery and deals specifically with co-occurring mental health conditions. At Searidge, the goal is to provide evidence-based therapies and holistic services that will help sustain long-term recovery. Clients receive individualized support and attention in an intimate setting that caters to just 12 residents. The therapy includes cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), group therapy, journaling, acupuncture, meditation, yoga, creative art therapy, and recreational therapy.

The facility overlooks the Annapolis Basin and is designed to provide an ideal environment for healing. The surrounding area is serene and green and offers plenty of space for walking or hiking. Searidge believes that privacy is an important element of successful addiction recovery, and as such, each client is provided with their own private room with a full bathroom. The center offers various amenities that include a heated pool, a library, and a game room with a pool table. All clients are provided with nutritious gourmet meals that are locally sourced and contain only the freshest ingredients.

pillars.title: Recreational Activities
pillars.body: Clients at Searidge Foundation are encouraged to engage in recreational activities as part of their addiction recovery. The center offers access to various recreational activities on and off-site. On-site, clients can enjoy the heated swimming pool, the library, and the game room. Off-site, there’s an opportunity to engage in activities such as whale watching, white water rafting, horseback riding, and group sports. The center also offers access to hiking trails for clients who love nature walks. The goal is to help clients achieve a balance between their recovery and relaxation time.

pillars.title: SMART Recovery Meetings and a Year of App Support
pillars.body: Aftercare at Searidge starts before you go home. Residents begin going to SMART Recovery meetings during their stay, so the online group already feels familiar by graduation, and the bi-weekly meetings carry on afterwards. Every graduate also gets a year of support through the Recovery Path app, with daily check-ins, goals and sessions with licensed addiction therapists who already know them. Families have their own weekly Friends and Family SMART Recovery meeting online, and the centre says graduates can keep their aftercare going for as long as they want.

pillars.title: Philosophy and Values
pillars.body: The core philosophy of Searidge Foundation is to provide the highest quality of care for anyone struggling with addiction and mental health disorders. The center believes in offering a holistic approach to addiction recovery that addresses the psychological, medical, pharmaceutical, nutritional, alternative, and spiritual practices that will support long-term recovery. Searidge aims to create an environment that is supportive, welcoming, and encourages clients to achieve their goals in safety. The center’s staff is committed to treating each client with respect, compassion, and understanding.

overview: Searidge Drug Rehab and Addiction Treatment Centre has been providing effective drug addiction treatment services in Nova Scotia, Canada since its establishment. The center operates with the aim of making quality drug rehab affordable and accessible to individuals with drug addiction dependencies. Searidge Drug Rehab is known for its highly individualised recovery programs and its commitment to maintaining a consistently excellent level of quality. The center accommodates only 12 residents at a time, which allows for a more personalised approach to recovery and ensures that each resident receives the best treatment possible.

As a leader in effective treatment for substance abuse, Searidge Drug Rehab and its sister drug rehab center, Sobriety Home in Quebec, offer a comprehensive recovery plan for drug addiction and concurrent disorders. Residents and their families are provided with the necessary support and guidance through the Sobriety Home Treatment Program to help them overcome addiction. The center is dedicated to improving addiction treatment techniques and supports ongoing research on PTSD and addiction memory at McGill University, led by Dr. Alain Brunet, as well as on addiction and anxiety disorder at the University of Florida. Searidge Drug Rehab and Addiction Treatment Centre is committed to delivering quality care to individuals with drug addiction and providing them with the tools they need to achieve lasting recovery.

afterOverview: Searidge treats addiction and mental health at the same time. During a stay, its consulting psychiatrist can diagnose and treat depression, anxiety, OCD, PTSD, bipolar disorder and ADD, and where medication helps, the physicians can prescribe naltrexone, methadone or Suboxone. For benzodiazepines the clinical staff follow a modified version of the Ashton Protocol. Therapy draws on CBT, REBT, psychodynamic therapy, cognitive bias modification and motivational interviewing, and the centre also runs laughter therapy sessions guided by filmmaker Albert Nerenberg.

location.heading: Searidge Foundation in Annapolis Royal, Nova Scotia
location.intro: Searidge sits on the Evangeline Trail at Annapolis Royal, at the western end of Nova Scotia's Annapolis Valley, with the Annapolis Basin below the property. Halifax is about two and a quarter hours away by Highway 101, while Digby and its ferry to Saint John, New Brunswick are about 30 minutes off, Middleton about 35 minutes and Kentville about an hour and a quarter.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Searidge Foundation cost?
faqs.a: Recovery.com lists a 30-day stay at Searidge at $14,640, as an estimate of the cash rate, and describes it as tax deductible. Searidge does not publish fees on its own website, so ask admissions for the current price and what it covers when you call 1-888-777-9953. The centre says it was set up to offer quality treatment at an affordable cost for Atlantic Canadians.

faqs.q: How long is the program at Searidge Foundation?
faqs.a: The program at Searidge Foundation can last anywhere from 30 to 90 days.
Yes, the center offers medically supervised detox services to ensure clients’ safety and comfort.

faqs.q: Where is Searidge and how do I get there?
faqs.a: Searidge is at 3289 Evangeline Trail in Annapolis Royal, in Nova Scotia's Annapolis Valley, about two and a quarter hours from Halifax. The centre offers free pickup and return anywhere in Nova Scotia within 250 km, free rides from the Digby ferry terminal for people coming from Saint John, and a complimentary pickup at Halifax Stanfield International Airport for people from outside the province. Pickups farther away in Nova Scotia or New Brunswick carry a small per-kilometre charge.

You keep going to the SMART Recovery meetings you started during your stay, and you get a year of support on the Recovery Path app, including check-ins and sessions with licensed addiction therapists who know you. faqs.q: Is Searidge a private centre? Can I use my benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, Searidge is a private, fee-based centre, and it does not describe any public funding through Nova Scotia Health or MSI. Recovery.com notes that most private insurance in Canada does not cover rehab, but some employee benefit plans do, so check with your plan before you book. Recovery.com also describes the fee as tax deductible.

faqs.q: What types of addiction do you treat?
faqs.a: The center offers treatment for various addiction types that include alcohol, drugs, gambling, and sex addiction.

No. Searidge says it is not a 12-step program and bases its treatment on behavioural therapy, using the Sobriety Home Method developed by its founder, Catherine Cosgrove. If a resident wants 12-step support, staff will take them to local AA or NA meetings.
Searidge treats men and women over the age of 18. Because each resident has a private room with a full bathroom, residents can also bring a pet with them.

faqs.q: Are family members allowed to visit?
faqs.a: Yes, family members can visit clients after the initial two weeks of treatment.

faqs.q: What's the maximum number of clients the facility can accommodate?
faqs.a: The facility is designed to accommodate a maximum of 12 clients for personalized attention and care.

faqs.q: Are medications used as part of the treatment program?
faqs.a: Yes, medications are used alongside other evidence-based therapies to ensure holistic approaches to addiction recovery.
